# GitHub

> GitHub is the AI-powered developer platform for building, collaborating, and shipping software with Copilot, Actions, and enterprise-grade security.

GitHub provides a comprehensive platform for version control, CI/CD automation, code review, and AI-assisted development. It serves developers from individuals to large enterprises with integrated tools for collaboration, security, and deployment.

## Key Topics

- GitHub Copilot
- GitHub Actions
- GitHub Codespaces
- GitHub Advanced Security
- CI/CD automation
- Code review
- Secret Protection
- CodeQL
- Dependabot
- GitHub Enterprise
- GitHub Issues
- Copilot Autofix
- AI-powered development
- Collaboration tools
- Developer platform

## AI-Powered Development

- [GitHub Copilot](https://github.com/features/copilot): GitHub Copilot AI code completion tool with IDE integration and LLM model options.
- [GitHub Spark](https://github.com/features/spark): GitHub Spark no-code AI-powered full-stack app builder with prototype-to-production.
- [GitHub Models](https://github.com/features/models): GitHub Models platform for building AI projects with prompt engineering and deployment.
- [MCP Registry](https://github.com/mcp): MCP Registry directory for discovering and integrating AI servers and development tools.

## Core Development Features

- [GitHub Actions](https://github.com/features/actions): GitHub Actions CI/CD automation platform with workflow, deployment, and marketplace.
- [GitHub Codespaces](https://github.com/features/codespaces): GitHub Codespaces cloud-based IDE for secure remote development and collaboration.
- [GitHub Code Review](https://github.com/features/code-review): GitHub code review via pull requests with branch protection and team collaboration.
- [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/features/issues): GitHub Issues project planning and tracking tool with agile workflow automation.
- [Features Overview](https://github.com/features): GitHub features overview covering collaboration, code review, CI/CD, and security.

## Security & Compliance

- [GitHub Advanced Security](https://github.com/security/advanced-security): GitHub Advanced Security with secret protection, vulnerability detection, and Copilot Autofix.
- [GitHub Code Security](https://github.com/security/advanced-security/code-security): GitHub Code Security with CodeQL analysis, dependency scanning, and AI-powered fixes.
- [GitHub Secret Protection](https://github.com/security/advanced-security/secret-protection): GitHub Secret Protection with push protection and secret scanning for compliance.

## Platform & Enterprise

- [GitHub Enterprise](https://github.com/enterprise): GitHub Enterprise for large organizations with security, governance, and Copilot.
- [GitHub for Teams](https://github.com/team): GitHub team collaboration platform with CI/CD, Dependabot, and community features.
- [GitHub for Startups](https://github.com/enterprise/startups): GitHub for Startups program offering credits, Copilot, and enterprise tools.
- [Why Choose GitHub](https://github.com/why-github): GitHub value proposition for enterprise, teams, and developers with AI capabilities.

## Marketplace & Extensions

- [GitHub Marketplace](https://github.com/marketplace): GitHub Marketplace for apps, tools, and AI models to enhance development workflows.

## Documentation & Resources

- [GitHub Docs](https://docs.github.com): GitHub documentation hub for users, developers, admins covering all products and features.
- [GitHub Homepage](https://github.com): GitHub homepage showcasing AI-powered developer platform with Copilot, Actions, Codespaces.
